en: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.
Not good enough quite yet.
You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.
My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.
Not ready yet!
My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.
They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.
Aww, bummer!
Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.
Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!
Shot down in flames!
Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.
Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?
Why?\nWhy'd I lose?
Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.
I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!
I knew it!
Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.
C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!
